name: cli-prototype-verify-gate-multistage
description: M20 X-rider (Wave 1): the Q2 multi-stage verify gate's refuse -> narrow -> pass loop, sibling to M18 X2's cli/prototype-verify-gate (which pins the pre-Q2 single-command gate). One CLI inbound drives a scripted tool loop: record a 3-stage `.copperclaw/verify` (lint/typecheck/test), write a correct app.py, run the lint stage, attempt todo completion (REFUSED naming `typecheck, test`), run the typecheck stage, attempt completion again (REFUSED naming only `test`), run the test stage (all stages now green, dirty cleared), attempt completion (ALLOWED). Proves the refusal narrows as individual stages turn green rather than gating on a single pass/fail bit. Registered in tests/replay.rs via the same subprocess re-exec X2 used (forbid(unsafe_code) blocks std::env::set_var). See README.md.
